product.name: AI-Driven Bereavement Subscription Management Service
product.description: A service that helps organizations efficiently process death notifications and manage the termination, modification, or transfer of subscriptions and contracts of deceased individuals.

identifier.value: White Label Platform for Multi-Organization Subscription Management

product.name: White Label Platform for Multi-Organization Subscription Management
product.description: A platform that enables bereaved individuals to manage subscriptions across over 1600 organizations through a single interface, allowing cancellation, modification, or transfer of accounts.

identifier.value: Digital and Telephonic Intake and Verification Service

product.name: Digital and Telephonic Intake and Verification Service
product.description: A service that collects and verifies death notification data from bereaved individuals via digital forms and telephone support, ensuring accurate processing of subscription changes.

product.name: Closure platform
product.description: A digital platform that guides bereaved families through managing practical, financial, legal and digital affairs after a loved one’s death.
